clue.text: Head of security in store has complete authority

indicators.note: the first letter sits inside the word for a store, as the clue says

parts.note: a depot is a storehouse or warehouse

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter, so only the start of security is taken

explanation.surface: The chief of security in a shop turns out to be in total control.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is descriptive: the answer is the one who has complete authority, so the phrase stands for a person rather than acting as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyrant or absolute ruler is someone who holds complete, unchecked power over others.

clue.text: Prophet is in jail", he garbled

indicators.note: something garbled is mixed up and confused, so the letters of the quoted words are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone quotes a man claiming a prophet is behind bars, but mangles the words.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament figure carried to heaven in a chariot of fire is one of the major Hebrew prophets.

clue.text: One place keeps royal member out as a rule

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it, so one part holds the other within it
the royal member stays out, on the outside, with the other letters held within

parts.note: a prince is a male member of a royal family
the Roman numeral for one is I
PL is the standard abbreviation for place, as in street names

explanation.surface: A single venue regularly shuts out a member of the royal family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeps' and 'out' read together: the royal member is kept on the outside of the other pieces. 'as a' is a link, and the clue as held lacks its enumeration.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle is a fundamental law or guiding standard of conduct, the same thing as a rule.

clue.text: Reservists arrested vile traitor in restaurant

indicators.note: to arrest is to seize and hold, so the reservists' letters hold the other piece inside

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

indicators.note: vile suggests something corrupted and twisted, signalling the letters of traitor are rearranged

explanation.surface: Part-time soldiers seize a despicable turncoat at an eatery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reservists' looks like the subject doing the arresting, but it only supplies the outer letters; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A trattoria is a simple Italian eating house, a kind of restaurant.

clue.text: Approach Heather for football strategy

parts.note: a tack is a course of action or approach to a problem
ling is another name for common heather

explanation.surface: A woman called Heather is approached about football tactics.
explanation.walkthrough: Heather looks like a woman's name, but it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Tackling, challenging an opponent to win the ball, is a basic defensive method in football.

clue.text: Shudder when Mark interrupts singer

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into the middle of something, so this letter goes inside

parts.note: a treble is a boy singer with a high voice
M is the abbreviation for mark, the old German currency

explanation.surface: A singer shivers when someone called Mark cuts in on the performance.
explanation.definitionFit: To tremble is to shake or quiver, the same involuntary movement as a shudder.

clue.text: Domestic found in Medici villa

indicators.note: the answer is found within the run of letters across the two words

explanation.surface: A household servant is discovered in the Medici family's villa.
explanation.definitionFit: Civil and domestic both describe matters internal to a country rather than foreign, as in civil war.

clue.text: Large legendary boat is broad and slow

parts.note: L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing sizes
the Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek legend

explanation.surface: A big mythical ship is wide and sluggish.
explanation.definitionFit: As a musical direction, largo means at a slow tempo and in a broad, dignified manner.

clue.text: New fashionable hairstyle for winger

parts.note: U means upper-class, socially acceptable, hence fashionable
a thatch is a thick mop of hair

explanation.surface: A trendy new haircut suits a footballer playing on the wing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winger' suggests a wide player in football; here it is something with wings, a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The nuthatch is a small songbird, and any bird can playfully be called a creature with wings.

clue.text: Sue set fire to institute entrance

parts.note: lit is the past tense of light, to set fire to
a gate is an entrance to a field or garden

explanation.surface: A woman named Sue torched the doorway of a college.
explanation.walkthrough: Sue looks like a woman's name but is the verb, to take legal action.
explanation.definitionFit: To litigate is to bring a lawsuit, so it means to take someone to court.

clue.text: Italian beset by simple truth

indicators.note: to be beset is to be surrounded, so this piece is enclosed by the other

parts.note: very can mean mere or sheer, as in the very thought, much like simple
It is short for Italian vermouth, as in gin and It

explanation.surface: An Italian man is surrounded by plain honesty.
explanation.definitionFit: Verity is a literary word for truth or a true principle.

clue.text: Lucky charm found in graduate's bed

parts.note: an MA is a Master of Arts graduate; the possessive gives the S
a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A good-luck token turns up in a university graduate's bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a person, animal or object believed to bring good fortune.

clue.text: Something soothing uttered in royal retreat

parts.note: a balm is a soothing ointment
oral means spoken aloud rather than written

explanation.surface: A calming remark is spoken at a palace hideaway.
explanation.definitionFit: Balmoral Castle in Scotland is the British royal family's private summer residence.

clue.text: Plan starts to make a point

indicators.note: the starts of the next three words are their opening letters

explanation.surface: A scheme begins with stating your case.
explanation.definitionFit: A map can mean a diagram or plan, and to map something out is to plan it.

clue.text: Musical talent appreciated by batsmen

definitions.meaning: the gift of naming or singing a note exactly without any reference tone
in cricket, a flawless playing strip is welcome to those batting

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the pitch is the strip of ground between the wickets; batsmen like one that is true and even.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses describe flawlessness: a faultless ear for notes, and a faultless cricket playing surface.

clue.text: Ditch worker for biting

parts.note: a trench is a long narrow ditch
a worker is a type of ant, so ant stands for worker in crosswords

explanation.surface: A labourer digging a ditch is chosen for a sharp remark.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenchant comments are incisive and cutting, which is what biting means of criticism.

clue.text: I denounce a criminal in Pakistan

parts.note: to slam is to criticise severely, to denounce
bad can mean wicked or criminal, as in a bad lot

explanation.surface: Someone condemns a lawbreaker in Pakistan.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition 'in Pakistan' stands for a place found in that country.
explanation.definitionFit: Islamabad is the capital city of Pakistan, a place located in that country.

clue.text: Security device makes mum more embarrassed

parts.note: mum means silent, and sh is the call for silence
people go red when embarrassed, so more embarrassed is redder

explanation.surface: A gadget for protecting secrets makes one's mother blush deeper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mum' looks like a mother; it is the word for keeping quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: A paper-shredding machine protects confidential documents, so it serves as a security device.

clue.text: Building wallah needed to pull strings

indicators.note: building means constructing, so the letters are put together in a new form

explanation.surface: A construction worker is required to use influence behind the scenes.
explanation.walkthrough: A wallah, from Hindi, is a person in charge of a particular task.
explanation.definitionFit: To engage in shrewd, sometimes shady bargaining is to use one's connections, like pulling strings.

clue.text: Deep blue

definitions.meaning: ... in pitch, as a deep voice is
sad and dejected, as in feeling down

explanation.definitionFit: A low note is a deep one, and feeling low means feeling sad and depressed.

clue.text: Bold expert restrains Scot

indicators.note: to restrain is to hold in, so one piece holds the other inside

parts.note: deft means skilful or expert
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A daring specialist holds back a Scotsman.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone defiant is boldly resistant, openly challenging authority.

clue.text: Admit King Charles's correct

parts.note: CR stands for Carolus Rex, King Charles; the possessive is a link
to edit is to correct a text

explanation.surface: A king called Charles concedes that something is right.
explanation.definitionFit: To credit a claim is to believe or accept it as true, much like admitting it.

clue.text: Shape-shifter made you and I mature, in retrospect

parts.note: you and I together are we

indicators.note: retrospect means looking back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: to flower is to come to full development, to mature

explanation.surface: A creature that changes form made the two of us grow up, looking back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retrospect' looks like a time phrase for the whole sentence, but it only turns the word for mature; 'made' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A werewolf is a person in folklore who changes into a wolf, a classic shape-shifter.

clue.text: Lager brewed for note writer

indicators.note: brewing mixes ingredients, so the letters of the beer are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A beer is brewed for someone writing a short message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note writer' suggests a letter or memo; here notes are musical, so it is a composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Elgar was an English composer, someone who wrote musical notes.

clue.text: Love area for fresh bracing air

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O
a zone is an area or region

explanation.surface: A romantic spot with invigorating breezes.
explanation.definitionFit: Ozone is used informally for the fresh, invigorating air of the seaside.

clue.text: Optical device advanced artist

parts.note: to advance is to come forward, so advanced gives came
RA is a Royal Academician, a member of Britain's Royal Academy of Arts

explanation.surface: A lens gadget helped a painter make progress.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera captures images through a lens, making it an optical instrument.

clue.text: Fuss about a soldier's slow movement

indicators.note: about means around, so the outer piece goes round the rest

parts.note: ado means fuss, as in much ado about nothing
a GI is an American soldier; the possessive is a link

explanation.surface: A commotion surrounds an infantryman's sluggish advance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slow movement' suggests a soldier's pace; it is a section of a musical work.
explanation.definitionFit: An adagio is a piece or movement played at a slow tempo.

clue.text: Restrict space to sleep in A&E? That's novel!

indicators.note: the pieces sit inside the outer letters

parts.note: taken as its two letters, A and E, the hospital emergency department
to dam is to hold back or restrict a flow
a bed is a place to sleep

explanation.surface: Being confined to a bed in hospital casualty would certainly be something new.
explanation.walkthrough: A&E is Accident and Emergency, Britain's hospital casualty department. 'novel' looks like 'new'; it means a book.
explanation.definitionFit: Adam Bede is the first novel by George Eliot, published in 1859.

clue.text: Endlessly interrupt production that's lascivious

indicators.note: a production is a staging or reworking, so the letters are rearranged
without its end, the word loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Constantly cutting into a show that is lewd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endlessly' drops the final T of INTERRUPT, leaving INTERRUP, which 'production' rearranges; 'that's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Prurient means having an excessive interest in sexual matters, close to lustful.

clue.text: Backed party in gallery until now

indicators.note: the reversed piece is placed inside the gallery name

parts.note: the Tate is a group of famous British art galleries in London and elsewhere

indicators.note: backed means turned back, so the word for a party is read backwards

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A celebration held in an art gallery has been supported until now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backed' turns DO into OD, which goes 'in' TATE.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means so far, up to the present time, the same as until now.
